title: Rememberence.jar
description:
This is the revival of Lifeless.jar. Play it of you Dare
One Player only!
body:
![Rememberence.jar Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4786ee0fd303cc87211acc1fd19420bec24f7fcb.png)

This mod is the revival of Lifeless.jar Adding in disturbing events even with your pc.
This horror mod wont show your IP Address but rather shows your Pc Username.


![A real threat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/393c52cc3fc9e0482e1437aabd92caa932c507ac_0.webp)

![Anomalies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3ec37497d52b9f46d83ee4109471940c7556144.png)

**_Rules_**

Do not play with a friend. This mod wont support 2 or more players in this (Certain events will break)

Do not play the mod with mods that alter world generation! (Certain events will break)

Do not play with shaders that change skybox (Certain events will break)


**THINGS YOU WANT TO KNOW BEFORE PLAYING**

This mod will Ban you,
This mod will send popups on your pc system,
This mod can shake your game window,
This mod will grief your world,
This mod will grief your builds,
This mod shows your Pc Username.

I recomend using your censore squares just incase whilst editing.

Rememberence.jar a (VERY) slow horror mod that will try to make you feel paranoid. There are random events, few entities and anomalies. All entities and anomalies are not safe and can make you have goosebumps or having the fear of distorted faces.

A Mod has some entities that are down right disturbing. With some analogue horror style things including the Main baddie "The Killer".

The killer is a tall slender like body with a creepy distorted face smiling in the distance. Just like the TBS entity "The Broken End" She will began to chase you and deletes your world.
